messages:
olivia: quick a11y QA on the Run -> Presets flow. Keyboard users lose visible focus after saving a preset. VoiceOver reads something but visual focus is missing so tabbing is confusing.
raja: ugh yeah i hit that too. can you paste repro steps?
olivia: repro: open Run panel -> Presets dropdown -> Edit preset -> Save. After save the sr-note gets read but theres no visible element focused.
maria: likely we're focusing a hidden `aria-live` node to trigger the message. pattern causes keyboard users to land on nothing.
chris: we did that originally to guarantee SR reads the change. but agree it's causing an accessibility regression.
a11y-bot: quick checklist: 1) avoid programmatic focus on hidden elements; 2) ensure visible focus ring on preset pills; 3) preset badge contrast >= 4.5:1 for small text; 4) restore focus to contextual element after modal flows.
raja: proposed change: keep the announcement in an `aria-live role="status"` region (polite) and programmatically focus a visible updated row (set `tabindex="-1"` then `row.focus()`). That way SR hears message and keyboard users have a visible target.
maria: also revert `.pill:focus { outline: none; }` we added earlier. must show a clear focus state — suggest `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ink)` + 2px solid border for high contrast.
olivia: color check: preset badge label falls ~3.7:1 on the light theme. fails AA small text. either darken label or tweak bg.
chris: what about using `--brand-600` for badge bg and `#0b0b0b` for text? I think that gets us >4.5:1.
raja: sounds good. sam (not in thread) did earlier color sweeps, but i'll run contrast tool and attach results.
a11y-bot: keyboard test cases to add: open modal -> tab through controls -> save -> focus returns to updated item; arrow keys navigate when focus inside list; Escape closes modal and returns focus.
maria: ARIA improvement: presets group currently `role:list` but items lack `aria-posinset`/`aria-setsize`. add those for SR users so they know their position in the set. also label the list with `aria-label="Presets"`.
olivia: copy note: keep toast terse: "Preset saved". don't cram context into the toast. rely on focus return for orientation.
chris: i'll author a PR: changes = 1) remove focusing of hidden live-nodes; 2) maintain polite aria-live for announcements; 3) after save, set `tabindex=-1` on updated row and call focus(); 4) restore visible focus styles on pills; 5) update badge color tokens; 6) add aria-posinset/aria-setsize on items.
raja: add unit test asserting focus return (use jsdom focus() mocks) and an integration axe run in CI.
maria: also add a small VoiceOver/TalkBack manual note in the PR for QE to validate on iOS/Android.
a11y-bot: post-merge: run screen-reader smoke on macOS+iOS+Android, and post results as a comment on the PR.
olivia: thanks y'all. small changes but reduces a lot of friction for keyboard/sr users. :thumbsup:
